outcomes_and_thesis.AGREEMENT: bicubic wins LPIPS-Alex on a majority with p < 0.05 -> thesis becomes 'the trivial arm wins on both axes measured; the released model does not beat do-nothing on this protocol on either endpoint'
outcomes_and_thesis.NULL: p >= 0.05 or split ~50/50 -> thesis becomes 'the perceptual endpoint does not separate the arms at n=100; the distortion ranking stands as the only decisive measure and remains a statement about the endpoint'
outcomes_and_thesis.REVERSAL: DiT4SR wins LPIPS-Alex on a majority of crops with sign-test p < 0.05 -> thesis becomes 'perception-distortion reversal on the measured crops: the trivial arm wins on distortion, the model wins on the perceptual endpoint; a fidelity-only table would have inverted the ranking'
outcomes_and_thesis.rule: in every outcome the 'not computed' thesis is rewritten, not appended (review-checklist.md:117-118); this worker does not edit papers/**

pairing: per stem, same 100 crops and same HR references in both arms; delta = LPIPS(bicubic) - LPIPS(dit4sr_local); positive favours DiT4SR
